description: Today's biggest US stock movers in StockFloc terms: stocks on fire (the largest gainers) and frozen (the largest losers), each with its percent change for the day. Use this when someone asks which stocks are on fire, frozen, or moving the most today. Returns up to 10 ticker symbols per side with percent change only: no prices and no quote for a specific ticker. Delayed about 15 minutes.

limit.description: How many per side (1 to 10). Default 5.

side.description: fire = top gainers, ice = top losers, both = both lists. Default both.

name: get_hot_stocks
title: Get today's fire and ice stocks
